name: combat-ward
description: Threat classification + ward management layer. Sits ON TOP of alerting — alerting still does notification routing; combat-ward turns threat-class events into bestiary encounters, ward actions, and a defense report. Migrated from os.realm.watch/servers/combat_ward.

cli.summary: Inspect the realm's defenses — threats, bestiary, encounters, wards, and the defense report

verbs.name: threats
verbs.table: (if type=="array" then . else [] end)[] | [.event_type // "-", (.severity // 0 | tostring), ((try (.raw_payload_json | fromjson.node) catch "-") // "-"), (.timestamp_observed // 0 | if . == 0 then "-" else (. / 1000 | strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")) end)]

verbs.name: bestiary
verbs.summary: Bestiary catalogue — fantasy creatures + encounter counts

verbs.name: encounters
verbs.summary: Active threat quests + linked ward actions

verbs.name: defense-report
verbs.summary: Realm defense summary — pending/executed actions, recent threats
